description: Add a recipe's ingredients to the shopping list at N servings. Omit ingredients[] to add all. Pass mealplan (id) to link the entries to that meal plan. Set servings to a negative value (e.g. -1) with list_recipe (id) to delete that shopping-list-recipe.

ingredients.description: Ingredient IDs to include. Omit for all.

mealplan.description: Meal plan id to link the entries to

servings.description: Default 1. Use a negative value (e.g. -1) with list_recipe to delete.

name: add_recipe_to_shopping_list
title: Add recipe to shopping list
